title: MATRA ฎีกา co-citation sidecar
description: case_id -> co-cited มาตรา ('the other provisions this Supreme Court ruling cites'). Lazy-loaded companion to matra-deka/v1 index.json; scoped to displayed cases only. Source: phoneee/thai-legal-corpus deka_citations (CC-BY-4.0), same graph inverted for index.json counts. Gives a searcher a 'what is this case about' fingerprint instead of a bare case number (added 2026-07-03).

refs.description: map: case_id -> array of co-citation tokens

items.description: co-citation token 'ABBR|section', e.g. 'ป.อ.|335', 'ป.พ.พ.|1598/1', 'ป.วิ.อ.|192'. ABBR maps to law_code via docs/alias_law_codes.json; section is verbatim (may carry ทวิ/ตรี or slash forms). The anchor มาตรา is kept in the list and filtered by the viewer at render time (so a case can be displayed under any of its cited มาตรา).
